description.value: Richmond E Bike is a Metro Vancouver e-bike specialist that has been selling, repairing, and servicing electric bikes, trikes, and scooters since 2014. The shop carries a broad range of e-bike parts and accessories, handles ICBC inspections, and offers rentals, making it a practical stop for touring cyclists needing e-bike-specific expertise. Custom-built e-bikes and conversion kits are also available for riders looking to electrify their existing setup.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at richmondebike.com loaded successfully and confirms this is an active e-bike specialist shop serving Metro Vancouver since 2014, with explicit repair services ('Repairs for all brands', dedicated 'Electric Bike Repair' and 'E-Bike Service' pages, ICBC Inspection & Repair). Parts inventory is confirmed by the website ('✔ Parts in stock') and the navigation lists tires & tubes, chains & lubricants, brake pads, derailleurs, and other touring-relevant parts. A 'Rental' item appears in the E-Bike Service navigation, confirming rental availability; no pump, washroom, or walk-in/same-day specifics are mentioned in the fetched content.
